dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So! Seen anyone who looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Hmm? A relative of yours, you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, nothing comes to mind. But I will keep my eyes out.

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: If anyone understands the pain of being separated from family, it's me...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: I wish you the best of luck, my friend.
